title: hazel-jit’s PR, Described
blurb: A working draft of the description for hazelgrove/hazel#2859, hazel-jit for dev, to iterate on before it goes on GitHub: an executive summary for whoever decides, an engineering summary for whoever reviews, then the details. Every evaluator test also runs compiled where it compiles: 234 of 289 do, and none differs from the interpreter. Beside ReScript, Melange and js_of_ocaml, hazel-jit now lays out records as they do, as plain objects; its constructors, options, calls and tail calls not yet. Their speed on the games of hazeljs-examples is still to measure.
